Thanks Ava — quick responses below:

- Confirmed: For revenue recognition to flow in the 3/31 close we must have a PO with an effective date no later than 3/24 and a matching invoice posted in our AP system within 48 hours. If PO effective date is 3/25 or later we will defer recognition to April close without an approved exception.
- Required PO fields: PO number, legal entity name, billing address, effective date, term length, net terms, currency, and contract reference (Redwood SOW#). Signed PDF emailed to finance@redwood.com is acceptable for ledger intake, but we need the PO document plus a confirmation email chain showing legal/ procurement approval.
- SLA exceptions: We can process an SLA exception but that requires filling out the attached SLA-exception-form.docx, approval from RevOps and the finance director, and a documented mitigation plan — typically a credit hold or contract amendment. Exceptions take ~72 hours to route.

Priyom — if you can estimate ARR/ deferred revenue impact that will help the approval case. Claire — if Nimbus can confirm whether the procurement review can be expedited or if a soft-commit effective date can be given (even if paperwork lags) that helps.
